name: Blood & Shadow 2

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description: Five collection levels that unlock the grid.

features.name: Sticky drop wilds
features.description: Wilds fall to the bottom and stay until they win.

review:
An occult 5x5 sequel where the bottom row starts locked and full of wilds. A Ritual Bar below the grid collects through five levels – each opens more of the board and adds Candle Spins, with +6 for reaching Reign of Terror Spins.

In the bonuses, wilds drop to the bottom and stay sticky until they're part of a win. xSplit can split rows or reels. Extreme volatility with a 16,161x max – far more aggressive than the original.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
